samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket misconfigured with public read access allowing unauthorized users to download sensitive project files.
indicators: GCS bucket IAM policy granting roles/storage.objectViewer to allUsers
Audit log showing external IP performing storage.objects.get on sensitive files
Access logs capturing GET requests from unknown external IPs
Sensitive internal design documents downloaded without authentication
Bucket ACL includes public read access
samples.detection_method: Regular audits of GCS bucket IAM policies with automated tools like Forseti Security; Monitoring GCP audit logs and alerting on storage.objects.get by unknown or external users; Analyzing access logs for unusual IP addresses accessing sensitive buckets; Implementing DLP to detect sensitive data exfiltration.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (Anonymous or public access)

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container configured with public read and list permissions, exposing confidential financial reports to unauthorized internet users.

azure_cli_commands_captured: az storage blob download --container-name confidential-reports --name Q2_financials.xlsx --file ./Q2_financials.xlsx --account-name financestorageaccount
az storage container set-permission --name confidential-reports --public-access blob --account-name financestorageaccount

indicators: Azure Blob container public access level set to Blob allowing anonymous read and list
Activity logs showing anonymous caller reading confidential financial data
Storage access logs with GET requests from external IP addresses
Confidential financial reports downloaded without authentication
CLI commands setting public access on container
samples.detection_method: Enforce Azure Policy to restrict public access on storage containers; Monitor Azure Activity Logs for anonymous or unexpected blob read operations; Analyze storage logs for data access patterns from unknown IPs; Use DLP to scan downloaded content for sensitive financial information.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket configured with public read and write access, allowing unauthorized users to upload malware and exfiltrate sensitive logs.
indicators: GCS bucket IAM bindings granting roles/storage.objectViewer and roles/storage.objectCreator to allUsers
CloudTrail event showing Anonymous user inserting objects into bucket
Access logs indicating POST requests from external IPs uploading executable scripts
Uploaded files containing malware payload scripts
Bucket ACL allowing WRITE permissions to allUsers group
samples.detection_method: Implement automated scanning of GCS bucket IAM policies to detect overly permissive roles; Cloud Audit Logs monitoring for anonymous object insertions; Access log analysis to alert on uploads from external IPs; Behavioral analysis on uploaded scripts for malware signatures; Enforce bucket-level public access prevention policies.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container with container-level public access enabled, allowing anonymous users to read sensitive financial reports and upload unauthorized files.

technical_data.suspicious_uploaded_file_sample: This document contains a macro that attempts to steal user credentials by sending them to attacker-controlled endpoint.
aws_cli_commands_captured: az storage blob upload --container-name financial-reports --name unauthorized_uploads/phishing_doc.docx --file phishing_doc.docx
az storage blob download --container-name financial-reports --name Q2_financials.xlsx --file local_Q2_financials.xlsx

indicators: Azure Blob Storage container public access level set to Blob, allowing anonymous read and write
Audit logs showing Anonymous users performing PutBlob operations
Access logs indicating PUT requests from unknown IPs uploading files with malicious macros
Presence of unauthorized files with embedded credential-stealing macros
No access policies restricting public write access
samples.detection_method: Use Azure Security Center and Azure Policy to enforce private container access; Monitor Azure Storage logs for anonymous or suspicious blob uploads; Implement Content Inspection and Endpoint Protection scanning uploaded documents for malicious macros; Configure alerts for public access level changes and anonymous write operations.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
